title: Spyderco Paramilitary 3 - Black G10 / Black CPM-S45VN Blade - C223GPBK
description:
Description:

The Paramilitary 3 is a smaller more compact version of the paramilitary 2.  The Para 3 has the same great features as the Para 2 such as the compression lock, S30V Blade and four position pocket clip.  The ramp on the back of the blade has a little steeper angle for better grip on the smaller blade.

This Paramilitary 3 is black G10 scales with a Black S45VN blade.

Features:
  • 3.00" Clip Point Blade in a black finish
  • Black G10 with stainless liners
  • Top Compression Lock Design
  • 4 Way pocket clip for right/left hand - tip up/tip down carry
  • Made in USA
Specifications:
Blade Material: CPM-S45VN
Blade Style: Clip Point in a black finish
Blade Length: 3.00"
Overall Length: 7.27"
Handle Length: 4.27"
Handle Material: Black G10 with stainless liners
Lock System: Top Compression Lock
Weight: 3.00 ounces
Pocket Clip: Right or Left Hand Tip Up or Tip Down
Country of Origin: USA
